title: Zack Gelof RC 2024 Bowman Chrome #78 Oakland Athletics A’s
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Bowman Chrome trading card featuring Zack Gelof of the Oakland Athletics. This card is part of the MLB set and has a card number of 78. It is a rookie card in the 2024 season, manufactured by Bowman, and falls under the Chrome parallel/variety. This collectible sports trading card is a valuable addition for baseball enthusiasts and card collectors alike.
